title: Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company files a Standard Offer Contract for Interruptible City-Gate Gas Supply with Seaman Paper Co.
petitioner: Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company d/b/a Unitil
filings: The Department of Telecommunications and Energy APPROVES the proposed interruptible city gate gas supply agreement between Fitchburg Gas & Electric Light Company and Seaman Paper Company. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul b. Vasington and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr.
